KONEXIT FLEET LTD's first micro-entity accounts, for the period to 30 April 2025, show cash at bank of £30,149.
In November 2025 Konexit integrated its platform with Shippeo for a transport visibility project covering more than 500 trailers operating between the UK and Northern Ireland.
Konexit's tracking platform works with hardware from Teltonika, Coban and Concox.
In October 2025 Konexit launched the Teltonika FTC880 IP69K-rated GPS tracker on its platform.
In August 2025 Konexit announced a partnership to supply connected dash cameras and telematics to Thames Valley Transport Services.
